# Cleaning report

Shows what each cleaning rule removed or flagged in the three datasets, with row counts before and after. It is the evidence behind the rule that a row is only modeled when `usable` is true.

*Generated by `src/02_clean/clean_data.py`.*

## FreshRetailNet-50K

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Train rows read | 4,500,000 |
| Eval rows read | 350,000 |
| **Total rows** | **4,850,000** |
| Censored (stockout hours > 0) | 2,135,444 (44.0%) |
| Bad discount (<= 0) | 17,339 |
| **Usable rows** | **2,710,168 (55.9%)** |
| Usable in train | 2,504,457 of 4,500,000 |
| Usable in eval | 205,711 of 350,000 |
| Series | 50,000, all complete daily runs |

Saved `fresh_clean.parquet`, shape (4,850,000, 18).

## Favorita (bakery, deli, poultry, prepared foods)

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Rows read | 11,284,633 |
| Dropped before 2014-04-01 (promo not recorded) | 2,256,065 |
| Dropped for negative `unit_sales` (returns) | 391 |
| Series total | 12,562 |
| Series kept (>= 365 observations, fill >= 0.5) | 8,993 |
| Rows after zero-fill | 9,805,048 |
| Zero-filled days | 1,419,430 (14.5%) |
| Date range | 2014-04-01 to 2017-08-15 |

Saved `favorita_clean.parquet`, shape (9,805,048, 9).

## Dominick's ccount (daily store-department dollar sales)

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Rows read | 324,133 |
| Dropped for impossible dates | 13 |
| Stores total | 128 |
| Stores kept (span >= 1000 days, fill >= 0.95) | 101 |
| Rows after calendar fill | 297,533 |
| **Usable rows** | **291,011 (97.8%)** |

Rows flagged as unusable:

| Reason | Rows |
|---|---|
| Customer count outside 100-20,000 | 6,415 |
| Bakery <= 0 or > 10,000 | 6,036 |
| Deli <= 0 or > 50,000 | 5,976 |

Saved `dominicks_clean.parquet`, shape (297,533, 10).

> **Note:** values are dollars (not units) from 1988-1997. 1988 is kept; confirm its start date in the Kilts data manual.
